content:
alex: quick idea: propose a timeboxed 'debt amnesty' approach for long-lived monolith slices so we can extract ownership without blocking feature work. RFC draft: https://redwood/rfcs/amnesty-draft

maria: interesting. scope = runtime surface or infra adapters too?

alex: start focused: session manager, kv-cache adapter, and the request router glue. keep runtime core unchanged for now. plan:
1) define minimal stable RPC contract for each slice
2) add compatibility shim in monolith for 3 months (logs deprecations)
3) parallel run + canary routing with fallback to monolith
4) incremental cutovers per-customer/route

sam: major risk is telemetry/tracing leaking between old and new services. we need a tracing contract (headers) and e2e traces during canary.

tess: also perf regressions — if new service adds 5–10ms p95 we're going to get tickets. suggest perf gates per slice.

alex: agreed. add perf guardrails (p50/p95 throughput and token/sec), and quality gates tied to our eval harness.

sam: volunteer to own the integration harness. I can create a testbed that replays traces and asserts contract and perf.

maria: how heavy should the API be? prefer protobuf or light JSON? we should pick something that supports fast schema evolution.

alex: prefer protobuf for binary perf and clear contracts. rough proto sketch:
```proto
service Session {
  rpc Get(SessionRequest) returns (SessionState);
}
```
Compatibility shim will accept old JSON and translate into proto.

infra-bot: integration cluster "amnesty-migration-test" created 2024-06-12T15:04:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria: fallback strategy? if contract fails in canary we need automatic routing back to monolith with alerting.

alex: implement routing policy: canary -> primary, on contract/quality failure -> automatic fallback + rollback flag. feature-flagged routing per-customer.

tess: break this into small slices — 2-week stories: API, shim, contract tests, perf smoke, canary. avoid big bang.

sam: timeline request: I can deliver harness + initial contract tests in 3 weeks. need owners and acceptance criteria.

alex: I'll draft the migration epics and owners. initial ETA: Q3 cycle start. owners: alex (program), maria (api/design), sam (tests/harness), tess (perf/gates).

maria: please add observability checklist (logs, spans, metrics) to each epic.

alex: will do. uploading draft RFC & epic list -> https://redwood/rfcs/amnesty-draft (comments open).

maria: :thumbsup:
